This establishes the current wrapper implementation boundary; because syzUSD is a variant, the date review retains its parent-inherited mechanism classification rather than declaring a redundant direct archetype.

collateral: Staked wrapper over Yuzu USD, backed by yzUSD reserve assets deployed into curated DeFi yield strategies and overcollateralized by protocol risk tranching
pegMechanism: Users stake yzUSD for syzUSD; syzUSD appreciates against yzUSD as strategy yield accrues, and final exits inherit Yuzu's KYC-gated primary redemption and liquidity-buffer constraints

oracleRisk.summary: syzUSD is Yuzu's staking wrapper over yzUSD; its share price accrues strategy yield and the wrapper does not expose a separate borrower collateral market or token-level liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: Yuzu documents syzUSD as a technical staking wrapper: users convert yzUSD into syzUSD shares and can unstake back to yzUSD. The reviewed wrapper has no borrower-owned debt positions or separate collateral/liquidation branches; underlying yzUSD mechanics remain a parent-asset dependency.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: syzUSD moves cross-chain between Plasma and Monad via a LayerZero OVault. Yuzu's own audited contracts (ovault/ProtoOVaultComposer and PSMOVaultComposer) inherit LayerZero's VaultComposerSync and wire an asset+share OFT mesh, with the share token (syzUSD) explicitly required to be an OFTAdapter lockbox (approvalRequired()==true) on the hub chain (most likely Plasma) and a standard OFT on spokes. Because the durable supply path for shares runs through a third-party (LayerZero) OFTAdapter lockbox control surface, this is an external lock/mint route rather than opaque. (Named DVN set and a live LayerZeroScan trace were not pinned, and the on-chain hub identity was not confirmed at the explorer/deploy-config level, but the lockbox/adapter requirement is code-enforced in the issuer's audited composer.)

review.evidence: syzUSD (variantOf yzusd-yuzu, variantKind strategy-vault) is an ERC-4626 staked wrapper over yzUSD on Plasma and Monad. It inherits yzUSD's permissioned-minter mint path and concentrated-admin posture; the wrapper only mints/burns shares against yzUSD deposits. 2026-07-20 follow-up resolved the open EOA-role question: on Plasma, vault owner() = EOA 0xceaff57fbcd0e8f095c5c1125dd09b93fc5bbf82 while the ProxyAdmin 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0 is owned by the separate 4/5 Safe 0xa2a9700407934e913c840556b3d29f19cf6f203d; on Monad, vault owner() = EOA 0x4ea00dc0c2b3933b9b41c6cc372832fe844a89ae (no code) while the ProxyAdmin 0x7040b88de8a8e63b9dffe2250f8062dcc1ca7331 is owned by 0xd32ab76a165f1a716986ba8c58344e3df4397f5e. The owner() EOAs are operational-only vault admins distinct from the upgrade admins; no MPC/HSM attestation for either EOA was found, so they are recorded honestly as EOAs.
